craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Opponent voice marked (so others plead — the verse stages its enemy); SP witness in NOTE not song. Rejected: (a) unmarking voice → killed: voice-marking is the retorsion setup. (b) conjoins→joins → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: NONE-barred FROM the MAN-y IN-one's-OWN-one-NESS — SO-oth-ers-PLEAD … THOUGHT a-LONE con-JOINS-them.

lines: None barred from the many in one's own oneness — so others plead:
unmixed in themselves, things — thought alone conjoins them.
l4.sanskrit_cite: naikasyaikye'pyanekasya bādha āhuryathā pare ityamiśrāḥ svayaṃ bhāvāstānyojayati kalpanā
notes: line 1 nominal, mirroring verbless SA; SP 5cd witness (Jha; MacCracken)

reads_against.argmap: Do the many need any unity at all? → The Buddhist position in its own voice: unmixed things, thought-joined; unity needs no seat.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
